title: Habits disappear after reload in Safari private mode
body:
**Steps**
1. Open the app in a Safari private window.
2. Add a habit called "Read 20 pages".
3. Reload the page.

**Expected**
The habit is still there, or the app tells me that it cannot save in private mode.

**Actual**
The list is empty and there is no message.

title: A habit can be marked done several times on the same day
body:
**Steps**
1. Add a habit.
2. Click "Done today" three times.

**Expected**
The habit counts once for today.

**Actual**
It shows "done 3 times". This will also break any streak counter we add later.

title: Add a streak counter next to each habit
body:
Show how many days in a row each habit has been done, up to today.

**Done when**
- The number is shown next to the habit name.
- Missing a day resets it to 0.
- A habit that is not yet done today still shows yesterday's streak.

Note: this depends on the bug about marking a habit done twice.

title: Daily reminder at a time I choose
body:
I forget to tick my habits. Let me pick a reminder time for each habit and show a browser notification.

Needed before exam week starts on 2 Nov 2026, because that is when most users will need it.

title: Dark mode
body: The page is very bright at night. Please add a dark mode that follows the system setting.

title: Add a dark theme
body: A dark theme would be easier on the eyes.
close_comment: Duplicate of the issue titled "Dark mode".

title: Export habits to a CSV file
body:
Add an Export button that downloads a CSV with one row per habit and one column per date.

**Done when**
- The file opens correctly in a spreadsheet.
- Habit names with commas are handled.

title: README has no setup or contribution steps
body: New contributors do not know how to run the app, where the code lives or how to report a bug. Add short sections for all three.

title: The app feels slow sometimes
body: Sometimes it takes a while. Can we make it faster?

title: Add automated tests for storage.js
body: loadHabits and saveHabits have no tests. Cover at least: nothing saved yet, saved data comes back unchanged, and broken JSON in storage returns an empty list.

title: Sync habits across my phone and laptop
body:
I use the app on two devices and the habits are different on each. Add accounts and sync.

This is large. It needs sign-in, a database and an API. Needed before the college fest on 15 Dec 2026.
